sloka: हर्षात्तदाब्रवीदिन्द्रो मयूरं नीलबर्हिणम् ।प्रीतो ऽस्मि तव धर्मज्ञ भुजङ्गाद्धि न ते भयम् ।। ७.१८.२३ ॥
transliteration: harṣāttadābravīdindro mayūraṁ nīlabarhiṇam ।prīto 'smi tava dharmajña bhujaṅgāddhi na te bhayam ।। 7.18.23 ॥

translations.english: Then, from joy, Indra spoke to the blue-feathered peacock, saying, "O knower of dharma, I am pleased with you, and indeed, you shall have no fear from serpents."
translations.hindi: हे भद्रे ! में लङ्क श्वर दशग्रीव हूँ । तू मेरी भार्या बन जा आर यथेष्ट सुखों को भोगा कर
